summary: 54-year-old skier stranded in a whiteout after a fall on Rabbit Ears Pass
notes: Date is approximate: source article URL is dated 2018-03-30 and reports the rescue occurred on a Wednesday. Skier became wet after a fall and could not put his skis back on; wore only a t-shirt and jeans in a whiteout with a winter weather advisory in effect.
